target.title: fix(openai): widen OAuth callback loopback check to full 127.0.0.0/8 range
target.body:
## What

Replaced the hardcoded `LOOPBACK_CALLBACK_HOSTS` Set (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`) with `isLoopbackCallbackHost()` that accepts the full 127.0.0.0/8 range via `startsWith("127.")`.

## Why

The OpenAI Codex OAuth callback host validation only accepted exact `127.0.0.1`, rejecting other valid loopback addresses like `127.0.0.2`. Container and sandbox environments commonly bind OAuth callbacks to addresses other than `127.0.0.1`. The canonical implementation in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` treats the entire 127/8 block as loopback.

## Evidence

- Affected file: `extensions/openai/openai-chatgpt-oauth-flow.runtime.ts`
- The `resolveCallbackHost` function is the only caller — no other code depends on the old Set
- The `resolveRedirectUri` function already handles `::1` bracket-wrapping correctly and works with any host
